  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCorrectly analyze ALFRED.B record structure.\nBased on the decompiled apply_alfred8_room_defaults:\n- Each record has: 2-byte room_id, 2-byte text_offset, 1-byte length, N bytes of data\n- The 2-byte values we were seeing are NOT a separate field!\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.B size: {len(alfb)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse records with variable length\n    # Format appears to be: 2-byte room_id, 2-byte offset, 1-byte length, data[length]\n    # Terminator is 0xFFFF for the room_id\n    \n    pos = 0\n    record_num = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alfb) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            out.append(f\"Found terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n            \n        text_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alfb[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alfb):\n            out.append(f\"Record {record_num}: truncated at pos {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        data = alfb[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'pos': pos,\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'text_offset': text_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n        record_num += 1\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total records parsed: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze the data bytes\n    out.append(\"First 30 records:\")\n    for i, rec in enumerate(records[:30]):\n        data_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'])\n        out.append(f\"  Room {rec['room_id']:2d} offset 0x{rec['text_offset']:04x} len={rec['length']:2d}: {data_hex}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Data byte distribution (first byte of each record's data):\")\n    first_bytes = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        if rec['data']:\n            fb = rec['data'][0]\n            if fb not in first_bytes:\n                first_bytes[fb] = 0\n            first_bytes[fb] += 1\n    \n    for b, count in sorted(first_bytes.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x}: {count}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Analyzing what these records restore in ALFRED.1 text sections...\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Read room directory from ALFRED.1\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            offset_pos = room * 26 + pair * 2\n            if offset_pos + 4 &lt;= len(alf1):\n                offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[offset_pos:offset_pos+4])[0]\n                pairs.append(offset)\n            else:\n                pairs.append(0)\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Check what context each record targets\n    out.append(\"Checking context around target positions in ALFRED.1:\")\n    \n    for i, rec in enumerate(records[:20]):\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        text_offset = rec['text_offset']\n        \n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            # Get pair 12 (text) offset for this room\n            pair12_offset = room_directory[room][12] if len(room_directory[room]) &gt; 12 else 0\n            \n            # The actual position in ALFRED.1\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + text_offset\n            \n            if target_pos &gt;= 5 and target_pos + rec['length'] + 5 &lt; len(alf1):\n                # Read context\n                before = alf1[target_pos-5:target_pos]\n                current = alf1[target_pos:target_pos+rec['length']]\n                after = alf1[target_pos+rec['length']:target_pos+rec['length']+5]\n                \n                before_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in before)\n                current_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in current)\n                after_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in after)\n                restore_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'])\n                \n                out.append(f\"Record {i}: Room {room}, pair12=0x{pair12_offset:x}, offset=0x{text_offset:x}\")\n                out.append(f\"  Position in ALFRED.1: 0x{target_pos:x}\")\n                out.append(f\"  Context: [{before_hex}] [CURRENT: {current_hex}] [{after_hex}]\")\n                out.append(f\"  ALFRED.B restores: {restore_hex}\")\n                \n                # Check if FB/FA is nearby\n                for j, b in enumerate(before):\n                    if b in [0xFB, 0xFA, 0xF1]:\n                        out.append(f\"  ** Marker 0x{b:02x} at offset-{5-j} **\")\n                out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alfb_correct_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alfb_correct_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCorrectly parse ALFRED.B targeting pair 12 (text) in ALFRED.1.\nDirectory structure: 56 rooms × 13 pairs × 8 bytes (offset + size) = 5824 bytes\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.B size: {len(alfb)} bytes\")\n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.1 size: {len(alf1)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse room directory correctly\n    # 56 rooms, 13 pairs each, 8 bytes per pair (4-byte offset + 4-byte size)\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104  # 13 pairs * 8 bytes\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    out.append(\"Room directory - Pair 12 (text data) offsets:\")\n    for room in range(10):\n        offset, size = room_directory[room][12]\n        out.append(f\"  Room {room:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08x}, size=0x{size:x}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.B records\n    pos = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alfb) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            out.append(f\"Found terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n            \n        text_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alfb[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n        \n        data = alfb[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'pos': pos,\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'text_offset': text_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total records: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Now check what's at target positions\n    out.append(\"Checking what ALFRED.B targets in ALFRED.1 text sections:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    fb_nearby = 0\n    fa_nearby = 0\n    \n    for i, rec in enumerate(records[:30]):\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        text_offset = rec['text_offset']\n        \n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            pair12_offset, pair12_size = room_directory[room][12]\n            \n            # Absolute position in ALFRED.1\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + text_offset\n            \n            if target_pos &gt;= 10 and target_pos + rec['length'] + 10 &lt; absolute 0x{target_pos:x}\")\n                out.append(f\"  10 bytes before: {before_hex}\")\n                out.append(f\"  Current value:   {current_hex}\")\n                out.append(f\"  10 bytes after:  {after_hex}\")\n                out.append(f\"  ALFRED.B data:   {restore_hex}\")\n                \n                # Check for FB/FA in the before context\n                for j, b in enumerate(before):\n                    if b in [0xFB, 0xFA]:\n                        out.append(f\"  ** 0x{b:02x} marker at position-{10-j} **\")\n                        if b == 0xFB:\n                            fb_nearby += 1\n                        else:\n                            fa_nearby += 1\n                out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(f\"Summary: {fb_nearby} FB markers nearby, {fa_nearby} FA markers nearby\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Let's look more specifically - check if pattern is: [FB/FA] [speaker_byte] [TARGET=08]\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Checking specific pattern: does FB/FA appear at offset-2 from target?\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    pattern_fb = 0\n    pattern_fa = 0\n    pattern_other = 0\n    \n    for rec in records:\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        text_offset = rec['text_offset']\n        \n        if room &lt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nUnderstand ALFRED.B's actual purpose.\n\nKey insight from decompiled code:\n1. When a conversation choice is selected, FB -&gt; FA at the marker position\n2. This write goes to ALFRED.1 file\n3. A journal record is written to ALFRED.A\n\nBut ALFRED.B restores 0x08 at position+2 from FB marker (the color byte).\nWhy would the color byte need restoration?\n\nHypothesis: Maybe when FB-&gt;FA conversion happens, something also changes\nthe nearby bytes? Or maybe ALFRED.B is for a completely different purpose.\n\nLet's check if there are any entries where the current value is NOT 0x08.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Parse room directory correctly\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.B records\n    pos = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alfb) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n            \n        text_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alfb[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n        \n        data = alfb[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'text_offset': text_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total ALFRED.B records: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check if any target position has a value != 0x08\n    non_08_targets = []\n    exactly_08 = 0\n    \n    for rec in records:\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            pair12_offset, _ = room_directory[room][12]\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + rec['text_offset']\n            \n            if target_pos &lt; len(alf1):\n                current = alf1[target_pos]\n                if current == 0x08:\n                    exactly_08 += 1\n                else:\n                    non_08_targets.append((room, rec['text_offset'], current, rec['data'][0]))\n    \n    out.append(f\"Targets where current value IS 0x08: {exactly_08}\")\n    out.append(f\"Targets where current value is NOT 0x08: {len(non_08_targets)}\")\n    \n    if non_08_targets:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(\"Non-0x08 targets (interesting cases):\")\n        for room, offset, current, restore in non_08_targets[:30]:\n            out.append(f\"  Room {room:2d} offset 0x{offset:04x}: current=0x{current:02x}, restore=0x{restore:02x}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Since ALL targets are already 0x08, let's think about WHEN this matters:\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"1. Fresh install: ALFRED.1 has original FB markers and 0x08 color bytes\")\n    out.append(\"2. After playing: Some FB become FA, but color bytes stay 0x08\")\n    out.append(\"3. On exit: ALFRED.A is deleted\")\n    out.append(\"4. On next start: ALFRED.B is applied... but everything is already 0x08!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Possible explanations:\")\n    out.append(\"a) ALFRED.B was created as a safety mechanism that turned out to be redundant\")\n    out.append(\"b) There's some other mechanism that corrupts the 0x08 bytes\")\n    out.append(\"c) The 0x08 bytes DO get changed during some operation we haven't found\")\n    out.append(\"d) ALFRED.B serves a purpose in save/load that we don't understand yet\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Let's check what HAPPENS if we look at offset-1 (the speaker ID)\n    # Maybe ALFRED.B is meant to restore those?\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Let's check if the byte BEFORE target (speaker ID) varies:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    speaker_id_values = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            pair12_offset, _ = room_directory[room][12]\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + rec['text_offset']\n            \n            if target_pos &gt; 0 and target_pos &lt; len(alf1):\n                speaker_id = alf1[target_pos - 1]\n                if speaker_id not in speaker_id_values:\n                    speaker_id_values[speaker_id] = []\n                speaker_id_values[speaker_id].append(room)\n    \n    out.append(\"Speaker IDs (byte at target-1) distribution:\")\n    for sid, rooms in sorted(speaker_id_values.items()):\n        room_set = sorted(set(rooms))\n        out.append(f\"  Speaker ID 0x{sid:02x} ({sid:2d}): {len(rooms)} occurrences across rooms {room_set[:10]}...\")\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alfb_purpose_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alfb_purpose_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/alf8_analyze.py)",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze ALFRED.8 structure - maybe IT restores FB markers?\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.8\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf8 = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.8 size: {len(alf8)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse room directory\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.8 records (same format as ALFRED.B)\n    pos = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alf8) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alf8[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            out.append(f\"Found terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if room_id == 0xCAC9:  # Alternative terminator\n            out.append(f\"Found 0xCAC9 terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alf8):\n            break\n            \n        local_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alf8[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alf8[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alf8):\n            out.append(f\"Record truncated at pos {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        data = alf8[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'local_offset': local_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total ALFRED.8 records: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze what the first byte of data is\n    first_byte_dist = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        if rec['data']:\n            fb = rec['data'][0]\n            if fb not in first_byte_dist:\n                first_byte_dist[fb] = 0\n            first_byte_dist[fb] += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"First byte of data distribution:\")\n    for b, count in sorted(first_byte_dist.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x}: {count}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Records where first byte is 0xFB (enabled conversation branch)\n    fb_records = [r for r in records if r['data'] and r['data'][0] == 0xFB]\n    fa_records = [r for r in records if r['data'] and r['data'][0] == 0xFA]\n    \n    out.append(f\"Records restoring 0xFB: {len(fb_records)}\")\n    out.append(f\"Records restoring 0xFA: {len(fa_records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    if fb_records:\n        out.append(\"First 20 FB-restoring records:\")\n        for i, rec in enumerate(fb_records[:20]):\n            data_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'][:10])\n            out.append(f\"  Room {rec['room_id']:2d} offset 0x{rec['local_offset']:04x} len={rec['length']:2d}: {data_hex}...\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.8 targets pair 10 (room metadata) by default.\")\n    out.append(\"But if first byte is 0x08 or 0xFA, it uses pair 12 (text).\")\n    out.append(\"So ALFRED.8 could restore conversation markers if it contains FB records!\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alf8_analysis_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alf8_analysis_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExamine the exact byte sequences around FB markers to understand the structure.\nUser says 0x08 is TEXT COLOR command followed by color byte.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Parse room directory\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Find all FB markers in text sections and examine structure\n    out.append(\"Examining FB marker sequences:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    for room in [2, 4, 5]:  # Check a few rooms with conversations\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = room_directory[room][12]\n        text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n        \n        out.append(f\"\\nRoom {room} (pair12 at 0x{pair12_offset:x}, size {pair12_size}):\")\n        \n        fb_positions = []\n        for i, b in enumerate(text_data):\n            if b == 0xFB:\n                fb_positions.append(i)\n        \n        out.append(f\"  Found {len(fb_positions)} FB markers\")\n        \n        # Show first 10 FB sequences\n        for i, pos in enumerate(fb_positions[:10]):\n            # Get context: FB and next 15 bytes\n            context = text_data[pos:pos+16]\n            context_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n            \n            # Decode the structure\n            if len(context) &gt;= 5:\n                fb_byte = context[0]\n                choice_idx = context[1]\n                byte2 = context[2]  # This is supposedly 0x08 (text color cmd)\n                byte3 = context[3]  # This would be the color value\n                \n                out.append(f\"  FB #{i}: pos 0x{pos:04x}\")\n                out.append(f\"    Raw: {context_hex}\")\n                out.append(f\"    FB={fb_byte:02x} choice_idx={choice_idx:02x} byte2={byte2:02x} byte3={byte3:02x}\")\n                \n                # Find end of this line (FD marker)\n                text_end = pos + 4\n                while text_end &lt; len(text_data) and text_data[text_end] != 0xFD:\n                    text_end += 1\n                \n                if text_end &lt; len(text_data):\n                    line_data = text_data[pos+4:text_end]\n                    try:\n                        # Try to decode as text\n                        text = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else f'[{b:02x}]' for b in line_data)\n                        out.append(f\"    Text: {text[:60]}...\")\n                    except:\n                        pass\n        out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check what byte3 values appear after 0x08\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Analyzing byte patterns after FB xx 08:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    byte3_counts = {}\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = room_directory[room][12]\n        if pair12_size == 0:\n            continue\n        text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n        \n        for i, b in enumerate(text_data):\n            if b == 0xFB and i + 3 &lt; len(text_data):\n                byte2 = text_data[i + 2]\n                if byte2 == 0x08:\n                    byte3 = text_data[i + 3]\n                    if byte3 not in byte3_counts:\n                        byte3_counts[byte3] = 0\n                    byte3_counts[byte3] += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"Byte after 'FB xx 08' (if 0x08 is color cmd, this would be color value):\")\n    for b, count in sorted(byte3_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x} ({b:3d}): {count} occurrences\")\n    \n    with open(\"fb_structure_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to fb_structure_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

        'current_data': current\n            })\n    \n    return results\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"GAME STATE RESET MECHANISM ANALYSIS\")\n   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the journal replay mechanism.\nCheck what ALFRED.A would contain if the game crashed mid-session.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef analyze_journal_concept():\n    \"\"\"\n    The journal hypothesis:\n    1. When FB-&gt;FA conversion happens, a 6-byte record is written to ALFRED.A\n    2. On normal exit, ALFRED.A is deleted\n    3. On crash, ALFRED.A persists with the changes\n    4. On next startup, if ALFRED.A exists, the game could:\n       a) REVERT: Read journal, convert FA back to FB \n       b) IGNORE: Just delete the journal\n       c) APPLY: The journal is only ever appended, never read\n    \n    To determine which, we need to find code that READS from ALFRED.A\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    out = []\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.A JOURNAL THEORY ANALYSIS\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # What we know about the journal record format\n    out.append(\"KNOWN: Journal Record Format (6 bytes)\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  [0:2] room_id (LE uint16)\")\n    out.append(\"  [2:4] local_offset (LE uint16)\")\n    out.append(\"  [4:1] length (always 1)\")\n    out.append(\"  [5:1] value (always 0xFA - the NEW value written)\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"KNOWN: What gets journaled\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - When handle_conversation_tree marks a choice as used:\")\n    out.append(\"    1. FB marker at ALFRED.1[room_offset + local_offset] -&gt; FA\")\n    out.append(\"    2. Journal record written: (room, offset, 1, FA)\")\n    out.append(\"  - This means the journal stores the NEW state (FA)\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 1: Journal is NEVER read (write-only)\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - Game just deletes it on exit\")\n    out.append(\"  - If crash, orphan ALFRED.A exists but is ignored\")\n    out.append(\"  - ALFRED.8/B are used to restore defaults on INSTALL\")\n    out.append(\"  - But wait... ALFRED.8/B don't restore FB!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 2: Journal enables CRASH RECOVERY\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - On startup, check if ALFRED.A has content\")\n    out.append(\"  - If yes: DON'T reset, game crashed mid-session\")\n    out.append(\"  - If no: Normal start, apply ALFRED.8/B defaults\")\n    out.append(\"  - This would explain why ALFRED.8/B don't reset FB\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 3: The original CD never modifies ALFRED.1\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - PACKET.001 contains all files\")\n    out.append(\"  - Install extracts to hard drive (creates ALFRED.1)\")\n    out.append(\"  - Fresh install = fresh ALFRED.1 with all FB markers\")\n    out.append(\"  - ALFRED.8/B restore non-conversation state (exits, hotspots)\")\n    out.append(\"  - FB markers are NOT reset - they accumulate!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"CRITICAL QUESTION:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  If FB-&gt;FA changes accumulate in ALFRED.1...\")\n    out.append(\"  How does starting a NEW GAME reset conversation state?\")\n    out.append(\"  \")\n    out.append(\"  Options:\")\n    out.append(\"  A) NEW GAME re-extracts ALFRED.1 from PACKET.001\")\n    out.append(\"  B) NEW GAME has special code to reset all FA-&gt;FB\")\n    out.append(\"  C) The game keeps conversation state in memory, not ALFRED.1\")\n    out.append(\"  D) ALFRED.A journal is used to track what to revert\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check what the current ALFRED.1 looks like\n    out.append(\"CURRENT STATE ANALYSIS:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Count FB vs FA in text sections\n    rooms = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        rooms.append(pairs)\n    \n    total_fb = 0\n    total_fa = 0\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = rooms[room][12]\n        if pair12_size &gt; 0:\n            text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n            total_fb += text_data.count(0xFB)\n            total_fa += text_data.count(0xFA)\n    \n    out.append(f\"  FB markers: {total_fb}\")\n    out.append(f\"  FA markers: {total_fa}\")\n    \n    if total_fa == 0:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(\"  ** Current ALFRED.1 appears PRISTINE (no FA markers) **\")\n        out.append(\"  This could mean:\")\n        out.append(\"    - Fresh install state\")\n        out.append(\"    - Game resets FA-&gt;FB on startup\")\n        out.append(\"    - ALFRED.1 was manually replaced\")\n    else:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(f\"  ** Current ALFRED.1 has {total_fa} used conversation choices **\")\n        out.append(\"  This means conversations have been progressed\")\n    \n    # Check ALFRED.A\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.A STATUS:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    if os.path.exists(\"files/ALFRED.A\"):\n        size = os.path.getsize(\"files/ALFRED.A\")\n        out.append(f\"  File exists: {size} bytes\")\n        \n        if size == 0:\n            out.append(\"  ** File is EMPTY - normal exit occurred **\")\n        else:\n            out.append(f\"  ** File has {size} bytes - {size // 6} journal records **\")\n            out.append(\"  This could indicate a crashed session!\")\n    else:\n        out.append(\"  ** File does not exist **\")\n    \n    with open(\"journal_theory_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to journal_theory_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    analyze_journal_concept()\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump save game content for analysis\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nsave_path = \"files/SALVAJOC.024\"\n\nwith open(save_path, \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nout = []\nout.append(f\"Save file: {save_path}\")\nout.append(f\"Size: {len(data)} bytes\")\nout.append(\"\")\n\n# Header\nout.append(\"HEADER (first 64 bytes):\")\nout.append(f\"  Magic: {data[0:16]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Save name: {data[0x10:0x26]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Room number: {data[0x26]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Player X: {struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x28:0x2a])[0]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Player Y: {struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x2a:0x2c])[0]}\")\n\nout.append(\"\")\nout.append(\"Hex dump (first 256 bytes):\")\nfor i in range(0, 256, 16):\n    hex_part = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    ascii_part = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    out.append(f\"  {i:04x}: {hex_part}  {ascii_part}\")\n\nout.append(\"\")\nout.append(\"Searching for FA bytes in save file:\")\n\nfa_positions = []\nfor i, b in enumerate(data):\n    if b == 0xFA:\n        context = data[max(0,i-3):i+4]\n        fa_positions.append((i, context))\n\nout.append(f\"  Found {len(fa_positions)} 0xFA bytes\")\nif fa_positions[:20]:\n    out.append(\"  First 20:\")\n    for pos, ctx in fa_positions[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"    0x{pos:04x}: {ctx.hex()}\")\n\nwith open(\"savegame_dump.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n\nprint(\"Output written to savegame_dump.txt\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/GAME_STATE_RESET_ANALYSIS.md)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/GAME_STATE_RESET_ANALYSIS.md)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "# Game State Reset Mechanism - Complete Analysis\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nAfter extensive analysis of the Alfred Pelrock game's code and data files, here is the definitive understanding of how game state reset works:\n\n### Key Finding: NO DYNAMIC FB RESTORATION EXISTS\n\nNeither ALFRED.8 nor ALFRED.B contains records to restore FB conversation markers. The game **does NOT reset conversation state (FB markers) on startup**.\n\n| File | Records | Restores FB? | Purpose |\n|------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| ALFRED.8 | 82 | **0** | Room metadata (exits, hotspots, walkboxes) |\n| ALFRED.B | 1180 | **0** | Text color bytes (0x08) |\n\n## The Three Categories of Game State\n\n### Category 1: Persistent State (Saved to SALVAJOC.XXX)\n- Player position (X, Y)\n- Current room\n- Inventory items\n- Conversation branch states (memory array at 0x0004fba4)\n- Various game flags\n\nWhen loading a save: The game reads these from the save file and restores them to memory.\n\n### Category 2: Room Data State (Modified in ALFRED.1, Reset by ALFRED.8)\n- Hotspot positions (can be moved offscreen to disable)\n- Exit enable/disable flags\n- Walkbox configurations\n\nOn startup: &#96;apply_alfred8_room_defaults&#96; reads ALFRED.8 and patches these values into ALFRED.1, restoring the default room configurations.\n\n### Category 3: Conversation Text State (FB/FA markers in ALFRED.1)\n- FB = Available conversation choice\n- FA = Used/exhausted conversation choice  \n\n**CRITICAL: These are NEVER reset by any startup code!**\n\n## How Conversation State Actually Works\n\n### During Gameplay (handle_conversation_tree at 0x00018690):\n1. Player selects a conversation choice marked with FB\n2. FB is changed to FA in ALFRED.1 (via write_data_to_alfred1)\n3. A journal record is written to ALFRED.A: &#96;[room:2][offset:2][1][0xFA]&#96;\n4. Memory array at conversation_branch_state_array is updated\n\n### The Journal (ALFRED.A) Purpose:\n- **Write-only during gameplay** - stores FA conversions\n- **Deleted on normal exit** - &#96;thunk_FUN_00031f2d(\"alfred.a\")&#96; called at end of &#96;game_initialization&#96;\n- **NOT read for revert purposes** - No code reads journal to restore FB markers\n\n### The ALFRED.B Purpose:\nAll 1180 records restore &#96;0x08&#96; (text color command) at offsets 2 bytes after FB markers:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nText structure: FB [choice_idx] 08 0D [text...]\n                              ^^ ALFRED.B targets this byte\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nThis restores text formatting, NOT the FB marker itself.\n\n## Why FB Markers Don't Need Resetting\n\nThe game's design assumes:\n\n1. **Fresh Install = Fresh State**: ALFRED.1 is extracted from PACKET.001 during installation with all FB markers intact.\n\n2. **No \"New Game\" Feature**: The game has no way to start over except reinstalling.\n\n3. **Save Games Store Memory State**: The conversation_branch_state_array (224 bytes at 0x0004fba4) tracks which conversations are exhausted. This is saved/loaded separately from ALFRED.1.\n\n4. **ALFRED.1 Modifications Accumulate**: As you play, FA markers accumulate in ALFRED.1 across sessions. This is intentional - the file reflects your total game progress.\n\n## The Real Reset Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nINSTALL:\n  PACKET.001 → extract → ALFRED.1 (pristine, all FB)\n  \nSTARTUP (every time):\n  open_all_resource_files()     → Opens ALFRED.A (creates if needed)\n  load_alfred8_and_alfred9()    → Patches room data defaults to ALFRED.1\n  [game runs]\n  thunk_FUN_00031f2d(\"alfred.a\") → Deletes journal on clean exit\n\nLOAD SAVE:\n  conversation_branch_state_array ← loaded from SALVAJOC.XXX\n  (ALFRED.1's FA markers are NOT modified - they persist)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implications for ScummVM Implementation\n\n### What Must Be Saved:\n1. conversation_branch_state_array (224 bytes) - which conversations are exhausted\n2. Inventory items\n3. Room flags/states\n4. Player position\n\n### What Should NOT Be Modified in ALFRED.1:\n- FB/FA markers should probably be kept in memory only\n- Or stored in save game, not the resource file\n\n### ALFRED.8/B Application:\n- Apply ALFRED.8 room defaults on startup (exits, hotspots, walkboxes)\n- ALFRED.B text color restoration may be unnecessary if text is parsed correctly\n\n## File Summary\n\n| File | Format | Purpose | When Applied |\n|------|--------|---------|--------------|\n| ALFRED.1 | Resource file | All room data, text, sprites | Read at runtime |\n| ALFRED.8 | Patch records | Room metadata defaults | Startup |\n| ALFRED.B | Patch records | Text color bytes | Startup (may be redundant) |\n| ALFRED.A | Journal | Tracks FB→FA changes | Write-only, deleted on exit |\n| SALVAJOC.XXX | Save game | Memory state snapshot | Load game |\n\n## Open Questions\n\n1. **Why journal if not for revert?** Possibly for debugging, crash recovery detection, or abandoned feature.\n\n2. **Can the game be completed multiple times?** If FB markers accumulate, eventually all conversations become FA and the game might be unplayable without reinstall.\n\n3. **Why restore 0x08 bytes?** All targets already have 0x08. Possibly defensive coding or the original ALFRED.1 had different values during development.\n",

}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCompare save games to understand conversation state storage.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef analyze_save(path):\n    with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    result = {\n        'name': data[0x10:0x26].rstrip(b'\\x00 ').decode('latin-1'),\n        'room': data[0x26],\n        'size': len(data),\n        'fa_count': data.count(0xFA),\n        'fb_count': data.count(0xFB),\n    }\n    \n    # Check for conversation state array (should be 224 bytes somewhere)\n    # Look for patterns\n    \n    return result\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"SAVE GAME COMPARISON\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    saves = []\n    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(\"files\")):\n        if fname.startswith(\"SALVAJOC\"):\n            saves.append(os.path.join(\"files\", fname))\n    \n    for path in saves:\n        info = analyze_save(path)\n        out.append(f\"Save: {os.path.basename(path)}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Name: {info['name']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Room: {info['room']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Size: {info['size']} bytes\")\n        out.append(f\"  0xFA bytes: {info['fa_count']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  0xFB bytes: {info['fb_count']}\")\n        out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Now check ALFRED.1\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.1 Analysis:\")\n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Count in text sections only\n    rooms = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        rooms.append(pairs)\n    \n    text_fb = 0\n    text_fa = 0\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = rooms[room][12]\n        if pair12_size &gt; 0:\n            text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n            text_fb += text_data.count(0xFB)\n            text_fa += text_data.count(0xFA)\n    \n    out.append(f\"  FB markers (text sections): {text_fb}\")\n    out.append(f\"  FA markers (text sections): {text_fa}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    if text_fa == 0 and text_fb &gt; 0:\n        out.append(\"** ALFRED.1 is pristine - no FA markers in text **\")\n        out.append(\"** Save games must store conversation state SEPARATELY **\")\n    elif text_fa &gt; 0:\n        out.append(f\"** ALFRED.1 has {text_fa} exhausted conversations **\")\n    \n    # Look for conversation state in save\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Looking for conversation_branch_state_array in saves...\")\n    \n    for path in saves:\n        with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n            data = f.read()\n        \n        # ## Summary: Answers to Your Questions

### A) What other data is involved in the game reset process?

**On startup, `apply_alfred8_room_defaults` applies:**

1. **ALFRED.8** (82 records) → Room metadata:
   - Exit enable/disable flags (offset 0x1BF+ in pair 10)
   - Hotspot positions (can be moved offscreen to disable)
   - Walkbox configurations (offset 0x213+)
   - NOT conversation FB markers

2. **ALFRED.B** (1180 records) → Text formatting:
   - Restores 0x08 (text color command) bytes
   - Targets position+2 after FB markers
   - Structure: `FB [idx] 08 0D [text]`
   - NOT the FB markers themselves

### B) Exactly what gets saved and what doesn't?

**Saved to SALVAJOC.XXX:**
- Conversation branch states at offset **0x34** (224 bytes = 56 rooms × 4 slots)
- Player position (X, Y at 0x28-0x2B)
- Current room (at 0x26)
- Inventory items
- Various game flags

**NOT saved (volatile):**
- Most room rendering state
- Audio state
- Cursor position

**Modified in ALFRED.1 but NOT relevant for state:**
- FB→FA marker changes (these are a **log**, not the active state!)
- The game uses the memory array, not ALFRED.1 markers, for conversation state

### C) How does reset actually work?

**The key insight:** There is **NO true reset mechanism**!

```
FRESH INSTALL:
  PACKET.001 → extracted → ALFRED.1 (all 1180 FB markers)

EVERY STARTUP:
  1. Apply ALFRED.8 → Reset room metadata (exits, hotspots, walkboxes)
  2. Apply ALFRED.B → Reset text color bytes (0x08)
  3. Initialize memory arrays to zero
  4. Load save game if selected → Conversation states loaded from offset 0x34

DURING PLAY:
  1. FB→FA written to ALFRED.1 (permanent log)
  2. Memory array updated (active state)
  3. Journal written to ALFRED.A (crash recovery? debugging?)

EXIT:
  1. ALFRED.A deleted
  2. ALFRED.1 changes persist
```

**The "journal" (ALFRED.A) appears to be unused for revert** - there's no code that reads it back. It may be:
- A debugging artifact
- Crash recovery indicator (if exists on startup = crashed)  
- An abandoned feature

**Starting a new game means reinstalling** - there's no "New Game" menu option in the original.

## Summary of Findings

### 1. FA Marker Placement (VERIFIED)
Your observation was correct! The FA "disabled" marker is written at **FB+2** (where 0x08 is), NOT replacing FB:

```
Before: FB [idx] 08 0D [voice_lo] [voice_hi] [text...]
After:  FB [idx] FA 0D [voice_lo] [voice_hi] [text...]
                 ^^ FA overwrites 0x08 here
```

**Ghidra evidence** at 0x18c48:
```asm
MOV byte ptr [ESI],0xfa  ; ESI points to FB+2, not FB itself
```

### 2. Which Branches Get Disabled (NEW FINDING)

**Two marker types:**

| Marker | Count | Behavior | Use Case |
|--------|-------|----------|----------|
| **0xFB** | 1180 | ONE-TIME: Disabled after selection | Story-critical, can only ask once |
| **0xF1** | 192 | REPEATABLE: Never disabled | Info questions, can ask repeatedly |

**Ghidra evidence** at 0x18c3d:
```asm
00018c3a: MOV AL,byte ptr [ESI + -0x2]  ; Get marker 2 bytes before
00018c3d: CMP EAX,0xf1                  ; Is it F1?
00018c42: JZ 0x00018d0e                 ; If F1, SKIP disabling!
```

### 3. ALFRED.B Purpose (CORRECTED)
ALFRED.B **DOES reset conversation state** by restoring the 0x08 bytes that FA overwrote:
- Contains 1180 records targeting exactly the FB+2 positions
- All restore value 0x08
- On startup, this undoes all FA markers
